_comment: Configuration for ChatHealthyLogService itself. NOT appsettings.json:
that file is the .NET host's own logging configuration and belongs to the
framework. This file holds our settings, and ships in the build beside the
service binary so the deployed configuration is an artifact rather than an
environment variable someone set by hand.
Edit this file and restart the service. Nothing else needs to change.
logLevel   INFO for start, stop and anomalies only. DEBUG adds every
logDirectory  Relative to the service binary. 'log' puts the file in a
log/ folder of the deployment directory. Never Mongo: the
drain's identity cannot write the log database, and a log
worth reading does not belong in a collection.
